Adds a web application asset. This enables you to manually define application targets with high granularity using a combination of FQDN, port, protocol, and path.

Manually defining assets ensures that cumulative scan data is accurately condensed and attributed to the correct application, providing more precise reporting and analysis. <div class="perms-callout">Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE` custom role privilege.
